notes.title: The release date of Biped 2!
notes.content: [p]Greetings, adventurers![/p][p][/p][p]Today we have some great news for you: the full version of Biped 2 will be released [b]on November 5, 2025[/b]! [/p][p]A new journey is just around the corner — get ready for new locations, game mechanics, and brand new features as an even more convenient co-op system and the ability to customize your character.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="N9NDROVfsLc;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character customization is here!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, adventurers!
[/p][p]Today we are talking about a new feature available in Biped 2 — character customization! We have already touched on this topic in a recent development diary entry, but now we are ready to tell (and show) even more interesting details.[/p][p][/p][p]The colorful landscapes may change throughout your journey, but the bipedal robots will always be in the frame. If you have long wanted to diversify their appearance, or your exquisite sense of style requires you to immediately replace the chicken hat on the robot cat, the solution is already here![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/8fb3a54a58fc4ee11fb93cad9f054256e96e5fbd.png"][/img]In Biped 2, you will find a wide range of accessories for your characters - put a toad backpack or a crown on your hero; give him a guitar or attach a peacock tail. The accessories themselves will be divided into three categories: hats and glasses - for the “heads” of the bipeds, decorations that are attached to the back of the robots, and visual effects that accompany the character.[/p][p][/p][p]All decorations can be purchased by collecting in-game tokens scattered throughout the levels. Before you know it, you will have a wardrobe for your heroes and will be able to conquer the levels of Biped 2 in the style that you like the most! And if your friends in co-op mode say that a chicken hat does not go with a fox tail, remember that you can always throw the critics into the abyss.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/857de4f46763052c538b574a8db192e0713a58bd.png"][/img]Another important addition - all decorations and accessories will be available for in-game tokens; you will not be required to make purchases with real money. No microtransactions![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading this news - tell us what you think of the new fashion system! What costumes would you like to see in the game? We will carefully read all your suggestions![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, bipeds![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary: August
notes.content:
[p]
Hello, adventurers![/p][p][/p][p]Summer may be ending, but the biped party is just getting started and this fall, Biped 2 will be available for you and your friends! [/p][p]Thanks to your feedback on the demo, we have been regularly updating and improving the game: from small QoL changes to completely new mechanics.[/p][p]In this issue of the development diary, we will share good news with you and tell you what to expect in the near future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Achievements and awards[/b][/p][p]Every one of your comments and reviews has allowed us to significantly improve the game, and these improvements did not go unnoticed! We are pleased to announce that Biped 2 has won several prestigious gaming awards: Best in Category by TooManyGames and Game of the Year by ChinaJoy x Game Connection 2025.[/p][p]We are very happy that Biped 2 has already gained recognition even before its official release, and we hope that you, our beloved players, will enjoy the final version of the game too![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/fb92efe88257b0f22b5adc625f30ddcaaadcdbca.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fashion and Beauty[/b][/p][p]Many people have fallen in love with the new protagonist of Biped 2 — a robot cat in a chicken hat! But if you prefer more sophisticated outfits, then we have great news — Biped 2 has a character customization system for you! You can buy clothes and accessories in the in-game store for coins and stars collected during levels. [b]Please note that coins and stars are not in-game currency and will not be spent on purchases: you only need to collect a certain amount to unlock the desired item.[/b][/p][p]There are plenty of new accessories to discover, from a Viking helmet to a frog hat — stay tuned for more details on this system![/p][p][/p][p]This concludes our dev diary, but we will stay in touch — write everything you think about the game in the comments here or on our social networks.[/p][p][/p][p]See you later, bipeds![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 100K Wishlists and China Joy 2025 “Game of the Year” Award!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Bipeds![/p][p][/p][p]We have awesome news to share with you. Firstly — huge thanks for helping us reach 100.000 wishlists! We couldn’t have done it without you. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/840d69ec249f78fd54f8180a2c7e6d779c2682fc.png"][/img][/p][p]This year Biped 2 was participating in the China Joy Game Connection event and won the “Game of the Year” award![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfm1799iokPAP-7sVizDxXL09YHR9j2ICW_XNBieyIz6E8W5oxeNC6p-Q27hNMxSS8oZNNjkWyK591ttZZdX_dIn3cm4veDa_Bpvbfm-FuckNc3e7gHPueEC5PxaPaIcCBntCLbRA?key=3y3gVSwmEl3sgY7CiBOscA"][/img][/p][p]We are very honoured and super happy to get this award. Huge thanks to China Joy and Game Connection for it! [/p][p][/p][p]Each and every day we are getting closer to the release date reveal — follow our Steam page and wishlist the game so you don’t miss the big news![/p][p]
[/p][p]See you later![/p]

notes.title: DevDiary: July
notes.content:
[p]Hello, adventurers![/p][p]Summer is in full swing, and during these hot days we're excited to bring you hot news about the development of Biped 2! In this diary, we'll share what our team has already accomplished and what lies ahead. Prepare for great news![/p][p][/p][p][b]Shared accomplishments[/b][/p][p]We've already told you that the development team is working on the transition from online to P2P format: this will allow players to enjoy the game in cooperative mode without lag and connection problems. And today we are happy to announce that the transition to the P2P system has been successfully completed! Play Biped 2 with friends from other countries and continents as comfortably as if they were sitting on the same couch with you... and if they pay you a visit IRL, just switch to local co-op mode![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/303a09386cdccc3ff319245d383329d6e4a84f47.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]...Very nice, but when is the game coming out?[/b][/p][p]That's a question we are excited to answer, adventurers! We know that many of you are eager to check out the full version of Biped 2, and the developers are working hard to bring you new mechanics, improved controls, and an updated co-op mode. And we are happy to announce that Biped 2 will be released[b] this fall![/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/878fa6db449d39abd322e30968546779a8728362.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]A few more things about the fall[/b][/p][p]If you are already daydreaming of colorful forests and the brisk atmosphere of autumn, you will love the new biome featured in Biped 2! In your adventures you will visit not only mountains and rivers, but also a beautiful autumnal forest. This forest will be the final biome added to the game, and we hope you enjoy its ambience as much as we do! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading this development diary! It won't be long until Biped 2 is released, but we'll definitely be back to bring more good news soon.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon, bipeds![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Biped 2 Demo Update is Live!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Bipeds![/p][p][/p][p]We are extremely excited to present a new demo update! We’ve got lots of feedback and made awesome changes to make Biped 2 an even better game for everyone. [/p][p][/p][p]So, what’s new? [/p][list][*][p]Peer-to-peer online connection — no more region selections or any other shenanigans. Now, coop mode works through the P2P connection system, which should drastically improve ping. connection quality and streamline the experience;[/p][/*][*][p]Easy and Hard mode selection — we’ve had lots of feedback about the puzzle difficulty and a need for a more relaxed experience, akin to the first game. We’ve added a new difficulty setting, so now you are in full control of your gameplay. Challenge lovers can tackle the hard mode, and if you are here just for the vibes with your friends, the easy mode is a perfect choice for you.[/p][/*][*][p]Brand new PVP mode — for the first time ever, Biped will have a 2 vs 2 PVP mode. Race your friends through the levels and see who is the fastest Biped! In the Demo, you can have a taste of one level in this new mode. [/p][/*][/list][p]Please share your feedback with us! It is a huge help for us, and we want to hear about your new experience with P2P connection, easy mode, and the PVP challenge. And don’t forget to wishlist and follow Biped 2 on Steam to be first to hear all the exciting news.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, adventurers![/p]

We are extremely excited to reveal the pre-order date for [b]our first official plushie[/b] — it've just began, on June 24th, at 1PM EST. Please give a warm welcome to Robot Kitty![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/5d13cd09fe446459a8d1edfe7ca2c888b75afd26.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/b3e67754af2faaf15fb7af822df5b7dda3da2c04.png"][/img][/p][p]We will be distributing the plushie through our partners, Makeship. Everyone who purchases Kitty [b]will also receive a Steam copy of Biped 2[/b] when the game releases. Pre-order yours now right [url="https://www.makeship.com/products/cat-plushie" style="button"]HERE[/url]! The pre-order will last for one month, till July 24th. After that date, the production and shipping phases will begin! [/p][p][/p][p]As for your Steam keys, you will get them directly from Makeship, so no other actions are required. [/p][p][/p][p]In July, we will have another toy available on Makeship as well — [b]the legendary Silo, perfectly round, perfectly cute![/b] And in the same manner, everyone who orders one will also get a Steam copy of Biped 2. [/p][p][/p][p]Are you excited to get a new cute plushie friend? Share your thoughts with us and don’t forget to follow for the upcoming news about the game and the Silo plushie. And don’t forget to share this post with your friends! [/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, Bipeds![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary: June
notes.content:
[p]Hello, adventurers!
[/p][p]We continue to work on Biped 2 and we are excited to tell you about the development process. Let's find out what's in store for the game in the near future!
[/p][p][b]Biped: it's not just on the screen anymore![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your votes and suggestions, we have chosen the design for toy Bipeds! Soon you will be able to buy plushies in the form of adorable robots — choose between the classic round robot design or the hero of the sequel: robot kitty. Or better yet, don't pick favorites and get both at once.
[/p][p][b]More locations and mechanics[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/94773373650ad01abe9224d10ac74c01b70c088f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Get ready to conquer water and climb stone walls! Our game designers have designed brand new locations that will bring Biped 2's new mechanics to life. Use the hook to pull yourself up between islets on the water and solve the puzzles that await you in the Temple of Stone.
[/p][p][b]United we stand[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/a8e9d16462f97c754e72c3a6fb8c0dd16e11a089.gif"][/img][/p][p]Having trouble connecting? Too much lag? We have a solution! We will be introducing a P2P connection system into the game: direct connection will allow you to play with your friends all over the world as if you were sitting on the same couch. And if you're really in front of the same screen, that's great — Biped 2 will continue to support local co-op play as well. Just one more reason to get together![/p][p][/p][p][b]Friends and rivals[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/0b743f16776cfc8520038421511243acf1f4f167.gif"][/img][/p][p]Want to compete as well as cooperate? We are pleased to introduce yet another new feature — PvP mode for two or four players! Fight not only against tricky puzzles, but also against your friends to find out who is the best adventurer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Platformers and platforms[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to announce that Biped 2 will be released simultaneously on all platforms, including Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch, with cross-platform play! We're working hard now to make sure Biped 2 is a great game on all platforms and will delight you with graphics, puzzles, location design, and the ability to play with friends. Stay tuned, and we will share more news with you![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary: May
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Thank you so much for your feedback on the Biped 2 Demo! We're very happy that you liked the demo and today we'll tell you what we're working on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/bd63ea035caa8c0c599719f9574ac8aaf475b12c.png[/img]
Thanks to your feedback, a lot of things have already been improved - for example, the camera controls. Also, in response to your comments, we will introduce a difficulty level system and make the tutorial less intrusive! In the release version of Biped 2 there will be two difficulty levels: easy and hard, which will affect not only the complexity of puzzles, but also by the number of tutorials. 

We want to make the access to co-op mode as easy and convenient as possible for users, no matter what region they are in. We have taken several steps to improve co-op mode: the Steam version of the game will support P2P-connections for more convenient two-player play. Also, the game will retain the previous local and online co-op modes. The region selection interface will be changed as well - now the player will be prompted to select a region immediately upon switching to online mode. We hope that this will make choosing servers more understandable and transparent for users. 

In addition to making technical and quality-of-life improvements, we continue to work on the content of the release version of Biped 2. So, now the team is working on colorful new biomes; these novel natural zones will add more visual diversity and even more interesting puzzles to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/22cbd034197024992ce1ee9111675d7a223c7f92.png[/img]
We are also actively adding new mechanics to the game! You will be able to use a special hook in new puzzles and new water areas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/2cfbdd9301503e3a1b320834c2c049a2332e0deb.png[/img]
This is the end of our diary, but we will surely come back with more details. 

Until then, so long and see you again, bipeds!

While playing the Biped 2 Demo, many of our Chinese players may have experienced issues with playing in co-op mode. We have released a small game update, and playing with friends will be more convenient and problem-free. Check out our guide to make sure your co-op adventures go great!

Before you go to coop mode, change this setting in the game's options ([b]for Chinese Mainland region only![/b]):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/9e92f509f35def08db106fbc9c235212ef5278ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Biped 2 Demo: Dev Diary
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

You already know that Biped 2 Demo is available on Steam, and a lot of players have become familiar with it! Some of the players came after completing the first part of the game, and for some, this chapter of the adventure was their beginning. We listened to feedback from old and new friends, conducted a survey, and watched videos from streamers and content creators. We did all of this to make Biped 2 as good as possible!

So, let's take a look at what has been done so far and what we still have to do.

[b]Beauty (and comfort) is in the eye of the beholder[/b]

The interface and camera are some of the most important elements of a game, especially for a cooperative puzzle game like Biped 2. Many people complained about the clunky camera movements, as well as the fact that the camera could freeze at an awkward angle in co-op mode. Of course, we immediately set out to fix this problem - we want you to solve puzzles, not suffer over in-game cameras! 

The same goes for the interface - we made it more beautiful and user-friendly so that it becomes a worthy framing for the gameplay.

[b]Complexity in simplicity[/b]

The balance - what an important word! Game developers of all genres care about it, and we are no exception. It's important to us that Biped 2 is a fun game while maintaining accessibility for both adults and young players. 

Many of those who have already tried the demo have complained about the difficulty of the game and the fact that puzzles often cause frustration and unwillingness to progress further. We are working on a solution to this problem, and the final version of the game will feature two difficulty levels - easy and hard. They will differ both in puzzles and mechanics and will provide interesting and enjoyable gameplay for all kinds of players.

[b]The path we'll walk together[/b]

Of course, the above changes won't be the only changes for Biped 2. New levels in the game will also include new mechanics (for example, the hook), secrets and various features that users will be able to discover on their own during the game. We also continue to work on many aspects of the game, such as accessibility, the convenience of co-op mode, and quality of life improvements. Feedback and suggestions are always welcome - feel free to express them on Steam, X, and Discord! 

We'll be back with more Biped 2 Demo updates, but until then, enjoy the game, adventurers!

notes.title: Biped 2: Dev Diary. Part 4
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

We’re back with more info on the features and game mechanics of Biped 2. You’ll be able to see them for yourself very soon, but for now, we'd like to tell you more about what we have in store for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/ff9f66aac8478f871116ed1eadd24b07d8a4b51c.gif[/img]

[h1]The Brave Four[/h1]

Just like with the first installment of the franchise, one of the main features of Biped 2 is its co-op mode. After all, it’s a lot easier and more fun to overcome challenges when you’re teamed up with a friend. But this time around, we’ve made some tweaks and changes to the mode to make it even more exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/287e3487c73c8697ac5ae6110121cd87d8a67a8f.gif[/img]

So get your friends together and get ready for four-player mode! You can play online or share a single screen using four controllers — whatever you prefer. And if you'd rather use keyboard and mouse controls, we’ve got you covered too — Biped 2 will allow one player to use PC controls while the other three use gamepads.

If you’ve played the first Biped in two-player co-op mode, you’ll be familiar with most of the features on offer here. For example, all four players will see each other on the same screen in real-time, and they’ll have to stick together to beat each level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/0fc3a412b87f966f2d49ed14cfc36c04cbf5f8f0.gif[/img]

But there’s new stuff too! We’ve carefully updated the game's levels and mechanics to make sure that four-player teams have a seamless experience. These updates include new visuals for some levels and slightly tweaked rules for certain gameplay mechanics. It's all designed to keep your adventure fun and easy to navigate.

[h1]Element(al)s of Surprise[/h1]

In the first Biped, you might have encountered robots that looked a good bit like the two main characters. In Biped 2, your potential companions include elementals, beings that can either help you traverse the levels or get in your way. There are fire, water, earth, and air elementals, and you'll find lots of ways to interact with them. For example, one thing you can do is…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/3e8dd56f677a5331e5e674c110d4c1ce6039828d.gif[/img]

[h2]Get them all rolling! [/h2]

Adventurers will come across special elemental “buckets” with a mark on them telling you how many elementals need to be put inside. Catch the element-based creatures and put them in the buckets to clear the way. And don’t worry, they aren't the type to hold a grudge — even if you throw them around or give them a good kick. Many of the game's mechanics actually require you to move elementals in a certain direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/c5caa72590d24c9860c0223d2c3f370dfd5f097a.gif[/img]

[h2]Combine and Conquer[/h2]

Sometimes, adventurers might need something special. A gust of wind to carry them far, far away? A stone platform hovering over a gaping chasm? That’s where elementals come in handy.
Look for special machines to help you combine elemental powers, then stock them with the elementals you’ve captured. Fire and water will create a strong gust of wind, water, and earth will make a sticky mud platform, and two earth elementals together will make a nice stone platform. It's like magic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/eaea47029e3db2b74dd275342531946e4387412b.gif[/img]

[h2]Containing the Elements[/h2]

There are elemental enclosures scattered throughout the game. You’ll need to fill them to progress through a given level. The enclosures say exactly how many elementals of a certain type you need but be warned: Catching elementals can be a bit like herding cats since some of them will try to escape by moving in the opposite direction. Teamwork is key here!

That’s all we've got to share about Biped 2 for today. What do you think of the new and improved mechanics? We’d love to hear from you.

See you later, non-quadrupeds!

notes.title: Biped 2: Dev Diary. Part 3
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

We’ve got some more details about the game mechanics you’ll encounter in Biped 2. Today we're going to talk about the Merging mechanic. In order to overcome some of the obstacles you’ll face on your journey, the bipeds will have to join forces and work together. Let’s see what you can look forward to.

[b]Special Drift[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/62bfeced977309d1dbc5329a7fba9e2f9c4786fb.png[/img]
This mechanic will probably be familiar to those of you who’ve played the first Biped game. However, the layout of the rails is more complicated now - they can consist of several tracks that converge and separate again. Adventurers will have to take on specific roles. After Merging, one biped will be in charge of moving along the rails and avoiding obstacles, while the other will gather items and throw them into special baskets in order to open the way forward.

[b]Shield and Projectiles[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/de47ff8cd1ad7b9a48b0b0471fda14ba7f13d93e.png[/img]
Shields up! As before, this mechanic puts one of the bipeds in charge of the “legs,” while the other one acts as the “arms.” While the first adventurer is progressing through the level, the other will deflect incoming projectiles using a special shield. Pay attention to the color of those projectiles. Red indicates offensive projectiles that disintegrate when they hit the shield, but yellow projectiles bounce off of it. By deflecting them with the shield, you might be able to activate an essential switch or open the way forward. 

[b]Floating Platform and Grappling Hook[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/7578552d4ff3f6cac6067db4f01434a8055df6cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/f7e8f124ceef79d9bfac85fe077582d539d10721.png[/img]
Even if you find yourself without solid ground to stand on and have to make your way through water or air, don’t panic! While one-character steers the floating platform, the other uses a grappling hook to latch onto special anchors placed throughout the level and pull the platform forward. However, you’ll have to be careful and keep inertia in mind. If you move too fast, you won’t be able to turn around, so teamwork is crucial. 

[b]Sliders[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/c088bb466b6c99e33efbecaebfcfb0462ed3f4a5.png[/img]
We all need to rely on something dependable sometimes... but sliders are just the opposite of that. When the bipeds merge and one of them latches onto an object, the slider will start moving along with your characters. You’ll have to carry it to a different location in order to progress through the level. During their journey, the bipeds will have to trade places multiple times - the biped who was carrying the slider will have to start moving through the level, and vice versa. 

[b]Cannon[/b]
Ready, aim, fire! The cannon is the last Merging mechanic we’re going to cover today. The bipeds will have to join forces once again - one of them moves the cannon while the other shoots it at targets.

Cannons come in several varieties. The water cannon can help you put fires out (when facing hostile fire elementals, for example), push objects with its stream, and fill special hollow targets with water. 

You’ll also find color-coded targets. If you’re hit by one of them with a projectile of the same color, another object of that color will break. But be careful - if you hit one of these targets with the wrong projectile, only the target itself will be destroyed. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/c13b77815eb72276d3b6acd025c85ba5dc09d60a.png[/img]
That’s it for the latest issue of our devlog. We’ll reveal more details about Biped 2 soon. Until then, tell us your thoughts on the new Merging mechanics in the comments below.

See you later, non-quadrupeds!

notes.title: Biped 2: Dev Diary. Part 2
notes.content:
Hey there, adventurers  !

We've got another update on the upcoming game Biped 2. Today we’re going to show you a selection of new game mechanics. You’ll face plenty of unfamiliar obstacles and dangers, but don’t worry! You’re definitely equipped to meet these challenges in co-op or single-player mode.

1.	Swinging Balls

Swinging balls are an obstacle you’ll have to evade. Every ball swings at the same pace, but in order to slip past one, you’ll need to plot your trajectory with great precision.

Adventurers might find themselves on rough terrain that hinders their movement, but if you work together, you can power through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/4078a09dde8342b25cbe54725b5471e63626246d.gif[/img]

2.	Move and Freeze

Some of you might find this mechanic familiar from party games you played as kids. Adventurers will have to make their way past hovering air elementals. As soon as any adventurer enters the area underneath an elemental, they’ll have a few seconds to freeze in their tracks. A special timer will indicate the remaining time.  If an adventurer fails to freeze fast enough, they will be teleported back to the start of the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/e57e18cb98c6b22ea802dab75703b5eaf1e42c1c.png[/img]

Sentinel Elementals may be positioned differently, flanking the platform the adventurers are trying to traverse. When this happens, the "freezing zone" will be rectangular rather than circular. Aside from that, the mechanic remains the same: just freeze before time runs out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/bcd400945aab057aa5094fa43bc5ffb3c39a69e3.png[/img]

3.	Tornado

Tornadoes occasionally appear on a level, threatening to trap an adventurer inside. To get out of a tornado, move your feet while facing away from the center of the tornado, or else turbulence will launch you in a random direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/e57e18cb98c6b22ea802dab75703b5eaf1e42c1c.png[/img]

4.	Floors and Ceilings

In order to traverse this portion of the level, adventurers will have to use sticky platforms located above and below them. Naturally, aside from agility, they’ll also need teamwork — one adventurer will serve as the team’s "legs," walking on the platform, leaving the other free to pick up and interact with items. But be careful — whenever the "floor" and "ceiling" switch places, the adventurers' will instantly be reversed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/3f96f9dd1d3c23054215a17e52671c9e59ed3e75.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/15a083bedd34c427562458ff0f2a0a6d65cdb61d.gif[/img]

That’s all for now! Stay tuned, and be sure to wishlist Biped 2! We’ll be back soon with more details about your upcoming adventures.

See you later, bipeds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/0830b8a88c2227f8a1de2302f2816894876a1e00.gif[/img]

notes.title: Biped 2: Dev Diary. Part 1
notes.content:
Dear adventure-seekers,

As you may already know, we're making Biped 2. And today we're ready to reveal some new secrets and details about what's to come!

As we've mentioned before, the game will be released simultaneously on PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch and will include local and cross-platform online co-op. It's also getting a new four-player co-op mode!

There's just one question: which challenges await our new rescue team (or lone hero, since the game will have a single-player mode as well)? Today we'll be lifting the veil a little to tell you more about the upcoming journey.

You can look forward to 16 levels that will test your determination, coordinated teamwork, and... mastery of the game's new mechanics! Here's some more info about them.

[h1]1. Hot Potato[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/1a3c7a9f8907ffe6ad3cd470eae46bd24e1f10ae.png[/img]

The rescue robots need to carry a ball to a certain spot in the level. But it's not as easy as it sounds! You have to kick the ball to get it moving, so calculate your trajectory well and make sure you get the ball past the obstacles and traps. Some challenges will require lightning-fast reflexes. The ball can "heat up,” at which point you'll have to immediately pass it to another explorer. Or it may change color after being kicked, requiring you to take turns kicking it.

[h1]2. Remote[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/1a1a42dc14997918113a80c3ed8f007c87e35a4b.png[/img]

This mechanic might remind you of a sliding puzzle or a dance-based arcade game. One of the explorers has a "remote,” a set of interactive cubes that activate platforms on the other explorer’s side that they can move across. Both will see the triggers that the first player has to step on, as well as the outlines of the platforms those triggers activate. But there's more to it than that! You’ll also have to watch out for fireballs flying over the platforms and coordinate your actions to change your route quickly.

[h1]3. Hang Glider[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/d3d8c9243fc5f99641c8effbb5e7f29536a76a49.png[/img]

Get ready to soar to new heights! In addition to the familiar rail rides, you can now go hang gliding. Spread your wings to get through the aerial parts of the level, but be careful—your glider will descend eventually, so calculate your trajectory exactly.

[h1]4. Helicopter[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/5fc491fdedba62b0793f2b8aef99ac24944d97a9.png[/img]

If hang gliding isn't enough for you, we've got you covered! A helicopter controlled by both players will take you even higher. As one of the explorers grabs onto the device and becomes the helicopter's "hands,” the other one can interact with various objects while in midair. The player controlling the helicopter has to skillfully navigate between locations to get the other player to the next passable area with pinpoint precision, while also enabling them to access new areas along the way.

Tell us what you think about these new mechanics. And, of course, stay tuned for new details on Biped 2. We’ve got plenty more to share.

See you later, bipedals!
